name: comp-322
title: Feedback Dialog
description: A trigger opens a dark dialog with a short intro linking to tutorials, documentation and Discord, a large feedback textarea, and a white Send feedback button.
use: You want to collect free-form feedback without sending users to a separate page.
avoid: There is no submit logic or success state, and the help links are placeholders that go nowhere.
a11y: The textarea is labelled for screen readers, but the help links open nothing and no success or error is announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Feedback button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a left-aligned bold heading, a grey line carrying three underlined inline links, a tall outlined textarea spanning the width, and a white Send feedback button aligned right.
behaves: The trigger fades the dialog in over a dimmed page; typing fills the textarea and the demo supplies a sample message. Send feedback does nothing, and the X or Escape closes it.
customise: Title, description, link labels and placeholder are hardcoded; only the message text is user input.
weight: light: One dialog and a textarea; no animation beyond the opening fade.
demo: Placeholder asks how to improve coss.com; an example message reads Love the new command palette!
issues: Send feedback has no handler, so the message is never submitted.
The tutorials, documentation and Discord links are dead placeholders.
polishWhy: Clean dialog with a generous text area; stock styling and inert actions.
